test_title: PYST 40 - SSC CHSL 2025 - English Language (Held On: 27 Nov, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Rearrange the following sentence parts to form a meaningful and grammatically correct paragraph:

P. He collected water from a stream into a pot and placed it over a fire.

Q. He brought the water to a rolling boil for several minutes, killing all the pathogens.

R. He took a drink of the clear, safe water, his thirst finally quenched.

S . He allowed the water to cool, then poured it through a cloth to filter out any sediment.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The sequence of the sentences forms a coherent and logical paragraph that describes the process of purifying water step by step.
 
• **Sentence P comes first** as it introduces the initial action of collecting water and placing it over a fire:
 
 
• "He collected water from a stream into a pot and placed it over a fire."
